paraphrase: The earth has no other support: by its own power alone it stands fixed in space, and on its surface all around dwell for ever the whole world of gods, demons, men and dānavas.

paraphrase: The earth has a power of attraction: a heavy thing in the sky, drawn by it toward itself, appears to fall; since the sky is the same all round, where could the earth itself fall?
